title: Application for a New Business Permit (Mayor's Permit)
description: Requirements and steps for getting a Business/Mayor's Permit for a new business in Dipolog City, from the City Mayor's Office – Business Permits & Licensing Division (BPLD).
department: City Mayor's Office – Business Permits & Licensing Division (BPLD)
schedule: Monday to Friday, except holidays. Exact office hours are not stated in the Citizen's Charter, so call ahead.
whoMayAvail: Enterprises / business owners in Dipolog City

items: Unified Business Permit Application Form, original (from CMO – Permits & License Division). If filed by an authorized representative: photocopy of the representative's valid ID and an authorization letter
Proof of business registration, 1 photocopy (whole set, letter size): DTI registration (sole proprietorship), SEC registration (partnership/corporation) or CDA registration (cooperative)
Photo of the owner, one of the incorporators, or the manager: 1 colored copy, letter size
Photo of the establishment (inside and outside view): 1 colored copy, letter size
Valid government-issued ID, not expired: 1 colored photocopy
Location of the business (Google Map print-out) showing the precise location and/or directions from the establishment to City Hall: 1 colored copy
If renting: updated lease contract and the lessor's business permit, 1 photocopy each. If not renting: certificate of non-rental, if applicable (original)
Certificate of Annual Inspection, original (legal size)

requirements.groupName: Special Requirements by Line of Business
items: Real estate lessors: Occupancy Permit and Building Permit, 1 photocopy each (Office of the Building Official)
Market stall, bus terminal stall, fishport, Boulevard Commercial Complex and airport stall owners: Certificate of Award, 1 photocopy and original
Meat shops, dressed chicken dealers, lechon manok/belly, fried chicken dealers, lechon services and similar: Meat Handler Certificate, original (City Veterinary Office)

Hotels, pension houses, inns, lodging houses and other Mabuhay accommodations, consultancy, travel and tours: confirmed application from the Department of Tourism and/or Affidavit of Undertaking, 1 photocopy
Lending services, lending investors and lending institutions: Certificate of Authority, 1 photocopy
Retailers of medicine/herbal products, drugs and cosmetics, bakeries, food supplements and similar: Affidavit of Undertaking to submit the License to Operate (FDA), if available, 1 photocopy
Banks, pawnshops, money remittance, money transfer and money exchange: BSP Certificate of Authority/Certificate of Registration or Affidavit of Undertaking, 1 photocopy
Gasoline stations and LPG dealers: Department of Energy Standard Certificate of Compliance or Affidavit of Undertaking, 1 photocopy
Water refilling stations: certification from Sanitation and Tax Declaration for machineries; laundry services: Tax Declaration for machineries (City Assessor's Office), 1 photocopy
Cooperatives: Certificate of Compliance from the City Cooperative Office, 1 photocopy and original
Junkshops, lumber and similar: Environmental Clearance from CENRO, 1 photocopy
Bars, music lounges and similar: Affidavit of Undertaking
Internet cafés, pisonet, WiFi vendo and similar: Affidavit of Undertaking, signage (original) and latest internet bill (PLDT/Globe/other provider)
Private schools: CHED accreditation (college) or DepEd accreditation (elementary and high school), 1 photocopy

Insurance, manpower agencies, radio/telecom/VAS providers, security agencies, gun and ammunition retailers, and pest control services: license, accreditation or registration from the national regulator, or an Affidavit of Undertaking (see the BPLD Citizen's Charter for the specific agency)

requirements.groupName: Submitted Upon Issuance of the Business Permit
items: Fire Safety Inspection Certificate, original (Bureau of Fire Protection)
Police Clearance, original (Philippine National Police)
Sanitary Permit to Operate, original (Sanitary/Health Office)

procedures.clientAction: Submit the accomplished application form and requirements to BPLD (Window 4).
procedures.providerAction: Receive and evaluate the documents, assess capitalization, taxes, fees and charges, then encode details and print the Tax Order of Payment (TOP).

procedures.clientAction: Pay the required taxes, fees and charges.
procedures.providerAction: Receive the Tax Order of Payment, accept payment and issue an official receipt.
procedures.fee: Based on Tax Ordinance No. 96-001, Series of 1996 (The Revised Revenue Code of 1997) and its amendments. For new businesses, business tax is based on capitalization.

procedures.providerAction: Receive receipts and other requirements, print the business permit, have it approved and signed, then record and release the permit and business plate.

contact.location: Business Permit & License Division, Ground Floor, Dipolog City Hall, Rizal Ave.

notes: Business permits must be renewed from January 1 to 20 every year; penalties apply after that unless the Sangguniang Panlungsod authorizes an extension.
Business tax may be paid annually, semi-annually or quarterly. Quarterly deadlines: January 20, April 20, July 20 and October 20. Late payment incurs surcharges and interest.
Other requirements under law and ordinance go through a post-audit: after you get the permit, the establishment is subject to inspection by the relevant city offices.
The Charter's one-hour total processing time does not apply during peak season, bulk transactions or system failure, and excludes time spent at other offices.
You can also apply for a new business permit or renew online through the Dipolog City Online Services Portal (eservices.dipologcity.gov.ph).

title: Renewal of Business Permit (Mayor's Permit)
description: Requirements and steps for renewing an existing Business/Mayor's Permit in Dipolog City at the City Mayor's Office – Business Permits & Licensing Division (BPLD).
department: City Mayor's Office – Business Permits & Licensing Division (BPLD)
schedule: Monday to Friday, except holidays. Exact office hours are not stated in the Citizen's Charter, so call ahead.
whoMayAvail: Enterprises / business owners in Dipolog City

items: Unified Business Permit Application Form, original (from CMO – Permits & License Division). If filed by an authorized representative: photocopy of the representative's valid ID and an authorization letter
Latest Business Permit, original
Financial documents: Audited Financial Statement of the preceding year and/or Certification of Gross Sales signed by the manager or proprietor, 1 clear photocopy (letter size)
Proof of business registration, if applicable: DTI registration (sole proprietorship; renewed by the proprietor every 5 years), 1 photocopy (whole set)
Photo of the establishment (inside and outside view), if applicable: 1 colored copy, submitted every 3 years. Capture the whole building/establishment
Valid government-issued ID, if applicable: 1 colored photocopy
If renting: updated lease contract, 1 photocopy

Bus terminal stall: Bus Terminal Clearance, 1 photocopy and original
Fishport: Fish Port Clearance, 1 photocopy and original
Boulevard Commercial Complex: Boulevard Clearance, 1 photocopy and original
Airport stall owners: Clearance, 1 photocopy and original
Meat shops, dressed chicken dealers, lechon and fried chicken businesses: Meat Handler Certificate, original
Hotels, lodging, travel and tours: Certificate of Accreditation, 1 photocopy
Drug, cosmetic, bakery and food supplement businesses: License to Operate, if applicable, 1 photocopy
Gasoline stations and LPG dealers: Standard Certificate of Compliance, if applicable, 1 photocopy
Water refilling stations and laundry services: Tax Clearance for machineries, 1 photocopy
Cooperatives: Certificate of Compliance, 1 photocopy and original
Junkshops, lumber and similar: Environmental Clearance, 1 photocopy and original
Internet cafés, pisonet, WiFi vendo: latest internet bill, 1 photocopy
Private schools: CHED or DepEd accreditation, if applicable
Insurance, manpower, telecom, security agencies, gun retailers, pest control: license/accreditation from the national regulator, if applicable

requirements.groupName: Submitted Upon Issuance of the Business Permit
items: Fire Safety Inspection Certificate, original (Bureau of Fire Protection)
Police Clearance, original (Philippine National Police)
Sanitary Permit to Operate, original (Sanitary/Health Office)

Other requirements under law and ordinance go through a post-audit: after you get the permit, the establishment is subject to inspection by the relevant city offices.
The Charter's one-hour total processing time does not apply during peak season, bulk transactions or system failure, and excludes time spent at other offices.
